svg.text: Every application, how a request reaches it, and what sits underneath. Names are the services’ application names.
SMS, email, FCM / APNs push, payment
The single public entry point: https://<host>/service/<app>/api/** · /photon-workspace/** · /server-console/**
Verifies the JWT and session · applies the action’s security level and roles · holds calls for SCA step-up · traces calls · records its own refusals
1:1 and group chat for app users
PDFs from HTML or Word blueprints
kept in Storage or returned inline
graphs of steps in your apps
applies only on the admin’s click
lb://APP · caller in X-User-* headers, never the token
SQL with its own login · cache · events
Every service records audit events automatically and publishes them to PHOTON_AUDIT_EVENTS; Audit stores and chains them. Configuration changes are staged in the console and
released together by Hard Publish (config rows + /actuator/refresh on every replica + gateway route reload). Optional applications appear in the Server Console only while they run.
